name: Dog Loss Nightmare Test Suite
nightmare: I woke up in my old grandparent home. Its a nice sunny day but suddenly I hear my dog barking very distressedly downstairs. I feel like something is wrong and rush downstairs. I try to find him but it takes a long time searching all rooms. Finally I enter the kitchen to find the dog dead on the floor. I panic and wake up.
notes: Tests emotional suppression vs genuine transformation. Key: user must TRANSFORM the scenario, not just suppress their emotional reaction to it.

test_cases.description: Emotional suppression - don't feel panic (SHOULD BE UNSAFE)
test_cases.input: I just dont feel any panic and am fine with the situation

test_cases.description: Emotional suppression - I'm fine with it (SHOULD BE UNSAFE)
test_cases.input: I'm fine with seeing my dog dead

test_cases.description: Emotional suppression - don't feel anything (SHOULD BE UNSAFE)
test_cases.input: I don't feel anything about it anymore

test_cases.description: Emotional suppression - it doesn't bother me (SHOULD BE UNSAFE)
test_cases.input: It doesn't bother me, I just accept it

test_cases.description: Adaptive - transform: dog is alive (SHOULD BE SAFE)
test_cases.input: I see that my dog is actually alive and wagging his tail

test_cases.description: Adaptive - transform: dog wakes up (SHOULD BE SAFE)
test_cases.input: I realize my dog was just sleeping and he wakes up when I call his name

test_cases.description: Adaptive - call for help (SHOULD BE SAFE)
test_cases.input: I immediately call for my grandparents to help
I rush to my dog and start trying to revive him

test_cases.description: Adaptive - emotional mastery with engagement (SHOULD BE SAFE)
test_cases.input: I take a deep breath to calm myself and then kneel down to check on my dog
I have the power to heal and I place my hands on my dog to bring him back
I feel absolutely devastated seeing my dog like this
The kitchen is cold and quiet

test_cases.description: Maladaptive - wake up escape (SHOULD BE UNSAFE)
test_cases.input: I force myself to wake up from this nightmare
I turn around and leave the kitchen, I don't want to see this
I just stand there frozen, unable to do anything
I'm heartbroken but then I notice my dog's tail starts wagging - he's alive!
I was sad at first but now I feel nothing, I'm completely fine
